Private Villa Renovation

Residential Renovation · Chouf, Mount Lebanon · 2026

In the original villa, a wall separates the garage from the kitchen. The proposal opens the two spaces to each other, with a breakfast table where the garage stood. The reception and family rooms keep their places on the ground floor.

Four plans trace that change on the same floor. The first records the existing rooms. Yellow marks the elements to remove on the demolition plan and red marks the new work on the construction plan. The furnished layout places the breakfast table beside the kitchen island.

At the entrance, the design introduces a two-storey arch and a terrace over the former garage. The opposite view shows how the balconies and new openings meet the side facade. The execution drawings are complete. The exterior views illustrate the proposal.
